title: Grateful Dead Live at Oakland Auditorium Arena on 1982-12-28
lineage: SBD > Master PCM > DAT/0 > Sony R500 > SEK'D Prodif Plus > Samplitude Professional v7.02 > FLAC16

ai_review.summary: Good late‑'82 soundboard capture of a high‑energy show highlighted by a smoking Shakedown and solid Terrapin performance.
ai_review.review: The recording is a respectable late‑1982 board source with clear enough sound to enjoy the set, though a few listeners note minor speed quirks and an absent transition between On The Road Again and Touch Of Grey. Musically the show shines – Jerry’s chaotic but compelling Shakedown (despite lyrical flubs) and a strong Terrapin make it a standout night, while the overall energy stays high throughout.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers praise the performance (especially Shakedown) and rate the board quality as good to excellent; a single very negative review drags the average down slightly, yielding an overall rating just above four stars.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally clear and crisp for a late‑'82 board (rated ~3.5‑4.0 by reviewers). No major dropouts, but some note a tiny speed discrepancy and lack of transition between two songs.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong first set with solid playing, but the transition between On The Road Again and Touch Of Grey is missing; Shakedown leads into Samson rather abruptly.

band_member_comments.Jerry: His guitar work is described as stellar despite lyrical flubs on Shakedown; some feel he was 'too fast' that night, and one reviewer sees the lyric mishap as a sad portent.
band_member_comments.Bob: Bob Weir gets a nod for adding humor during Samson ('thanks for the giggles Mr. Weir!!').
